name: Hakim bin Azman
bio:
Hakim's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the University of Malaya, specializing in automotive design and performance. After graduating, he gained valuable experience as a junior engineer with a local racing team before making the jump to Europe. His methodical approach to problem-solving, coupled with his knack for identifying marginal gains, quickly earned him recognition. 

At ART Grand Prix, Hakim is known for his ability to distill complex technical data into actionable strategies. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every member of the engineering team feels empowered to contribute their ideas. While he respects established procedures, he's always eager to explore innovative solutions that can provide a competitive edge. His meticulousness and dedication to pushing the boundaries of performance make him a valuable asset to the team.

He is driven by a desire to see ART Grand Prix at the top and constantly looks for ways to improve performance and reliability. Hakim's leadership is characterized by a combination of technical expertise and a genuine concern for his team's well-being.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: He has a focused gaze and a slender build, often seen wearing his team jacket even indoors.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a strong cup of Malaysian Teh Tarik before every race.
